name: smwsprites-custom-shooting-power-ups
title: Custom "Shooting" Power-ups
description:
This package lets you to create new "Shooting" based power-ups, where the player can shoot extended sprites, both new and old, depending on "power" state.

Comes with boomerang and hammer powers, that were originally made by 1524 (ICB) and 3 new powers.

More details is in the readme.

V.1.2 - Most notable changes are support for the item box and one new power.
